profiles.name: Current veil
profiles.description: The approved rendering as it exists now. Mineral, soft and slightly whitewashed.

profiles.name: Air
profiles.description: A little surface shows through. Softer contrast and slightly less colour density.

profiles.name: Clear glass
profiles.description: Cleaner separation and slightly stronger colour. More pop without becoming glossy.

profiles.name: Luminous
profiles.description: More emitted light and bloom, with the colour balance held close to the control.

profiles.name: Deep mineral
profiles.description: Denser colour, firmer blacks and stronger sphere depth. The least whitewashed option.

profiles.name: Soft wash
profiles.description: The lightest, most translucent and most whitewashed edge of the useful range.
